reason: S1 adds the selectable Prague EVM configuration through EVMVersion::prague(), EVMVersion::fromString(), and EVMVersion::name(), but H0 cannot select it. FuzzerUtil::testCompilerJsonInterface fixes settings.evmVersion to "berlin"; FuzzerUtil::testCompiler draws only from s_evmVersions ending at EVMVersion::paris(); and ProtoConverter::evmVersionMapping handles Program versions only through CANCUN. Thus H0 lacks input/configuration control for the newly introduced Prague-specific compilation surface. Although omissions of Shanghai and Cancun in s_evmVersions predate this commit, the unreachable Prague mode is newly caused by S1.
evidence: S1 adds static EVMVersion prague() returning Version::Prague.
S1 adds prague() to EVMVersion::fromString(), making "prague" a recognized external configuration value.
S1 adds Version::Prague and maps it to "prague" in EVMVersion::name().
H0 s_evmVersions ends with EVMVersion::paris(), so FuzzerUtil::testCompiler cannot choose EVMVersion::prague().
H0 ProtoConverter::evmVersionMapping has cases through Program::CANCUN and no Prague case.
recommended_action: Extend H0's EVM-version input spaces to include Prague: add EVMVersion::prague() to s_evmVersions and add a corresponding Prague Program version and mapping in ProtoConverter::evmVersionMapping; where appropriate, allow the JSON-interface harness to exercise "prague" instead of always fixing evmVersion to "berlin".
